##### Project general facts

London Square Twickenham Square is a residential neighbourhood of apartments and townhouses arranged around a landscaped garden square. The collection brings together one, two and three-bedroom apartments across several residential buildings and three and four-bedroom townhouses arranged around the square. Each home has its own private outdoor space, and the townhouses come with south-facing gardens.

At the heart of the development lies a communal landscaped garden with grass, benches and play areas, creating a calm green space right on the doorstep. Play areas and open lawns give families a quiet outdoor setting close to home.

Interiors feature wood-effect flooring to the hallway, kitchen and living areas, porcelain tiles to bathrooms and en-suites, underfloor heating throughout and a fitted wardrobe in the principal bedroom. Kitchens are finished with DuPont Montelli work surfaces and splashbacks and integrated Siemens and Electrolux appliances, while the townhouses add an island unit with storage and an integrated hob. Homes are handed over without furniture, ready to be styled to individual taste.

##### Parking

Driveway parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Twickenham is a leafy riverside town in the London Borough of Richmond upon Thames, known as the home of rugby at Twickenham Stadium. The town combines a busy high street with independent boutiques, cafés and restaurants along Church Street, and a weekly farmers' market adds to its village atmosphere.

Twickenham station offers direct rail services to Richmond, Clapham Junction and London Waterloo, with London Heathrow within easy reach. Richmond Park, Marble Hill Park, Kew Gardens and the walking routes along the River Crane and the River Thames are close by, as are well-regarded schools, a college, gyms and supermarkets.

Twickenham appeals to families and professionals looking for green space and a quieter pace of life within easy reach of central London. Houses are offered as freehold and apartments on a long leasehold tenure, making the neighbourhood a well-connected choice.
